second_blocker_error: RuntimeError: AgentV SDK evaluation failed: node: --import tsx is not allowed in NODE_OPTIONS
root_cause: src/slm_training/evals/agentv.py:119 publish_agentv_evaluation calls subprocess.run(['node', runner, ...]) with no env= override, so it inherits the parent process's ambient NODE_OPTIONS ('"--import tsx" --max-old-space-size=8192', set for unrelated TS tooling in this sandbox). Node rejects the --import flag when supplied via NODE_OPTIONS for a bare script invocation.

candidate_fix.location: immediately before the subprocess.run(command, ...) call in publish_agentv_evaluation
candidate_fix.diff:
env = dict(os.environ)
env.pop("NODE_OPTIONS", None)
completed = subprocess.run(
    command,
    cwd=runtime_root,
    check=False,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    env=env,
)
